description: Status bar buttons that run shell or VS Code commands and show live ON/OFF state. A lighter, stateful alternative to Action Buttons.
untrusted: Buttons defined in workspace settings run commands, so they are ignored in Restricted Mode. Buttons from user settings keep working.
config.buttons: Status bar buttons. Each button runs a shell `command` or a `vscodeCommand`, and can show a live ON/OFF state via `state`. Workspace buttons are merged with user buttons and ignored in Restricted Mode.
